ExecutionPacket.purpose: Add or update one approved task card without catalog, graph, or verification drift.
ExecutionPacket.contract-excerpt: Only an AcceptedTaskCard from M-TASK-VALIDATION may enter M-TASK-LIBRARY. The task card is canonical for metadata, while README.md and knowledge-graph annotations are derived and must change atomically.
ExecutionPacket.graph-entry-excerpt: M-TASK-LIBRARY accepts output from M-TASK-VALIDATION, conforms to M-TASK-TEMPLATE, is governed by M-GOVERNANCE, and is projected into M-CATALOG.

dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-1: Authoring, synchronization, stop-condition, and Beads evidence rules.
dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-2: Canonical metadata labels, visible sections, and progressive-disclosure structure.
dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-3: Strict validation decisions and hybrid evidence; only accepted can be published.

ExecutionPacket.verification-excerpt: Run V-M-TASK-VALIDATION, V-M-TASK-LIBRARY, V-M-CATALOG, and V-M-GOVERNANCE. Verify hybrid task evidence, local and supplementary links, unique thematic catalog projection, one graph annotation, and mentor wave acceptance.

assumptions.assumption-1: The task has an accepted validation decision with task-appropriate evidence.
assumptions.assumption-2: The stable task slug, controlled metadata, execution environment, prerequisites, assets, and supplementary links can be resolved before editing.

stop-conditions.condition-1: Stop for non-accepted validation, ambiguous metadata or environment, duplicate goal, missing prerequisite or asset, broken supplementary link, unavailable mandatory evidence, unexpected GitHub rendering, slug migration, or new permanent tooling.

notes.note-1: Workers should only read more context when the packet is insufficient.

CandidateValidationRecord.learning-goal: Independently authored one-sentence observable learning goal.
CandidateValidationRecord.decision-reason: Concise contract, quality, or duplication reason.
CandidateValidationRecord.wave-id: Wave child issue ID for accepted, otherwise none

notes.note-1: Only list graph facts that really changed in repository artifacts.

module-checks.command-1: Verify accepted validation status, exact metadata labels, controlled values, execution environment, and mandatory document anchors.
module-checks.command-2: Resolve prerequisite, asset, catalog, and supplementary links.
module-checks.command-3: Verify task-appropriate execution, type-check, trace, browser, or manual evidence.
module-checks.command-4: Prove that the task slug appears exactly once in thematic catalog tables and graph annotations.

required-evidence-anchors.marker-2: Условие / Критерии готовности / Теория / Подсказка N / Решение / Самопроверка
required-evidence-anchors.marker-3: Beads validation decision and mentor wave-acceptance status

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: A task change must not complete before catalog and graph synchronization is verified.

wave-follow-up.item-1: Compare canonical task metadata with the catalog row and graph annotation.

phase-follow-up.item-1: Run the full candidate-status, catalog projection, vocabulary, XML, link, evidence, acceptance, and sampled GitHub-rendering review.

FailurePacket.scenario: Task metadata and the student catalog disagree after an update.

expected-evidence.marker-1: Canonical task metadata and one matching README.md catalog row.
expected-evidence.assertion-1: The task slug and all projected metadata must match exactly.

observed-evidence.artifact-1: The task card contains one metadata value.
observed-evidence.artifact-2: The catalog row contains a different value or is missing.

FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Keep task metadata canonical, repair the derived catalog and graph facts, and rerun the full projection checks.

evidence-captured.item-1: Task, catalog, graph annotation, resolved links, and mentor-review status agree.
